summary: The candidate is mathematically correct with no gaps. The non-spanning classification and its ambient affine-index definition were checked directly in [Blanco and Santos, arXiv:1711.07603v3](https://arxiv.org/html/1711.07603v3): the four-point line bound excludes every classified alternative at size twenty. The parity equality, unique midpoint-pair correspondence, sink reachability, and maximum-principle proof of nonsingularity are valid, including empty-parity and cyclic-graph cases. The established ambient spanning makes the homogeneous map surjective, and the exact sequence correctly gives |det H| = |T|D. The relation rank modulo two is twelve, yielding |T| >= 16; determinant multilinearity correctly counts acyclic parent selections and yields 0 < det H <= 2^16. The accepted predecessor expressly supplies D >= 34 under the present hypotheses alone. As an additional exact check on its supplied twenty-point example, the midpoint relation rank is twelve modulo two and both det H and the exhaustive acyclic-selection count equal 9984, consistent with D = 78. The conclusion proves exactly the stated spanning assertion and volume bounds.
